final: WITH rfi_averages AS (SELECT rfistat, AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex FROM signals GROUP BY rfistat), overall AS (SELECT AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex FROM signals), above_overall AS (SELECT r.rfistat, r.avg_modindex, r.avg_modindex - o.avg_modindex AS difference FROM rfi_averages AS r CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.avg_modindex IS NOT NULL AND r.avg_modindex > o.avg_modindex), above_average AS (SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) AS avg_modindex FROM above_overall) SELECT a.rfistat, a.avg_modindex, a.difference, a.avg_modindex - b.avg_modindex FROM above_overall AS a CROSS JOIN above_average AS b WHERE b.avg_modindex IS NOT NULL
